configurations.description: Comma-separated list of case-sensitive glob patterns for event-local structured log attribute keys not to capture. Applies to Log4j MapMessage entries, SLF4J key-value pairs, Logback Logstash markers, and Logstash structured arguments. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. An exclude-only selector captures every key not excluded; "*" captures no structured attributes. This does not affect otel.event.name, MDC, or logger context.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.common.logging.structured-attributes.excluded

configurations.description: Comma-separated list of case-sensitive glob patterns for event-local structured log attribute keys to capture. Applies to Log4j MapMessage entries, SLF4J key-value pairs, Logback Logstash markers, and Logstash structured arguments. "*" matches any number of characters and "?" matches one character. Excluded patterns take precedence. An exclude-only selector captures every key not excluded. Under v3-preview, an absent or empty selector captures all structured attributes by default. MDC and logger-context attributes remain separate and opt-in.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.common.logging.structured-attributes.included
